newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Perfect Food to go into property.
newsitem.headline: Perfect Food to go into property.

text.p: Perfect Food Industries Bhd said it it proposing a bonus and rights issue and acquisitions of stock in four companies, which will change its activities from a food firm to a property developer.

In a statement issued at the weekend, the maker and distributor of foodstuffs said it was proposing a bonus issue of 6.63 million shares on a one-for-three basis and a proposed rights offering of 99.5 million new shares on a five-for-one basis at 3.00 ringgit a piece.

Perfect Food said it is seeking to buy 91 percent of Segi Objektif (M) Sdn Bhd for 563.29 million ringgit to be satisfied by an issue of 148.23 million new shares at 3.80 ringgit a share. Segi is involved in property, leisure and resort development.
The statement said Perfect Food is also seeking to buy 100 percent of the equity in property developers Saujana Triangle Sdn Bhd, Medan Prestasi Sdn Bhd and M.K. Development Sdn Bhd.
The acquisitions of the companies would be for Perfect Food shares priced at 3.80 ringgit a piece.

Perfect Food said it is seeking the transfer of its shares from the Second Board to the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE). It is also proposing to boost its share capital from 25 million to 2 billion ringgit and changing its name to Emkay Bhd.
In relation to its announcement, the KLSE said it would resume trading in Perfect Food's shares on Thursday. The stock closed at 11.30 ringgit on July 30.
